page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 24 dedicated vCPUs utilizing the x86_64 architecture. The underlying hardware is based on an Intel Xeon 6462C processor operating at a clock speed of 3.3 GHz.

The instance is configured with 48.0 GB of system memory, yielding a resource density of 2.0 GB of RAM per core. It does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. There are no integrated graphics processing units on this instance type.

Network connectivity is supported by an 18 Gbps baseline bandwidth. Given the high clock speed and the 1:2 memory-to-vCPU ratio, this instance is designed for compute-intensive workloads that do not require massive memory footprints or local storage. Suitable workloads include high-performance web serving, batch processing, and compute-heavy application servers.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.hfc8i.6xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual machine instance featuring 24 dedicated vCPUs and 48.0 GB of RAM. Powered by an Intel Xeon 6462C processor running at 3.3 GHz on the x86_64 architecture, this KVM-based server provides a resource density of 2.0 GB of memory per core. The instance does not include local storage or dedicated GPUs, relying instead on network-attached storage solutions. It offers an 18 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. With its high-frequency processor and balanced compute-to-memory ratio, the ecs.hfc8i.6xlarge is engineered for compute-intensive applications, batch processing, and high-throughput web serving workloads that require dedicated CPU resources without the overhead of local storage.
